title: TALLY
description: Sell your hours like your goods. A pastel shop-counter landing page for service-led small Shopify businesses, built around a perforated two-part claim ticket that stamps and detaches at checkout.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · Original SVG · Lenis

sections.title: Counter Top Bar (`Header.tsx`)
sections.summary: Sticky bar with the perforated Tally ticket mark, 5-item desktop nav with a sliding pastel mint pill indicator, live queue badge (`04 ON BENCH`), accessible motion pause/resume toggle, *"Issue a Ticket"* CTA, and a native `<dialog>` mobile drawer with Escape close and focus restoration.

sections.title: The Shop Counter (`Hero.tsx`)
sections.summary: Split editorial hero with masked headline *"Sell your hours / like your goods."*, merchant archetype quick-switcher, magnetic primary CTA, and an interactive **Front Counter Mat** featuring a clickable SVG brass counter bell (`CounterBellSvg`) that rings and stamps a two-part hero claim stub, followed by a 4-column ink ledger strip.

sections.title: The Perforated Ticket Runway (`CounterStage.tsx` — Signature Mechanic)
sections.summary: - Pinned scroll-and-click stage tracking a service order across four stops: `01 Booked at Checkout`, `02 Checked In at Counter`, `03 On the Workbench`, `04 Ready for Pickup`.
sections.customCodeReason: Contains interactive 3D/WebGL, procedural canvas, or pinned scroll-scrubbed stage requiring an HtmlEmbed + page footer script.

sections.title: Four Ways to Sell Time (`ServiceModes.tsx`)
sections.summary: 2×2 bento comparing *1-on-1 Fittings & Consultations*, *Drop-Off & Mail-In Repairs*, *Bespoke Product Add-Ons*, and *Small-Group Bench Classes*. Each card toggles live between **Online Cart Line** and **Shopify POS Bench** views.

sections.title: The Merchant Bench (`MerchantStories.tsx`)
sections.summary: Pauseable service-category ticker band, followed by three illustrated small-business dossiers with `CountUp` metrics and an inspectable **Receipt Stub `<dialog>` modal** (`#TLY-26-1050`, `#TLY-26-2150`, `#TLY-26-3325`).

sections.title: Rate & Deposit Recovery Ledger (`RevenueCalculator.tsx`)
sections.summary: Interactive range sliders (weekly bookings, average ticket value, checkout deposit %) that compute monthly recovered no-show revenue and highlight the recommended flat-rate plan (*Counter $19/mo*, *Workshop $49/mo*, *Guild $99/mo*).

sections.title: Counter Questions (`FaqSection.tsx`)
sections.summary: Sticky header + 5-question accordion animating height via `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr`.

sections.title: Open Your Counter (`IntakeSection.tsx` & `CounterForm.tsx`)
sections.summary: Client-validated onboarding form (store name, email, archetype, plan, service workflow note). Invalid fields shake once and focus the first invalid control. Valid submission never sends a network request; it stamps and detaches a personalized **Merchant Trial Pass (`TLY-26-XXXX`)** with one-click clipboard copy.

sections.title: Footer (`Footer.tsx`)
sections.summary: Full-width original SVG neighborhood street scene (`FooterShopfrontScene`) with a gently swaying hanging shop sign, section links, and motion pause control.
